WITH tx AS (
  SELECT t.transreg,
         t.ordertypedist,
         AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_shortint,
         AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvol
  FROM transactionrecord t
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
mix AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist,
         AVG(avg_shortint) AS mix_avg_shortint
  FROM tx
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT tx.transreg AS transaction_ref,
       tx.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
       tx.avg_shortint,
       tx.avg_optvol,
       tx.avg_shortint / NULLIF(mix.mix_avg_shortint, 0) AS shortint_ratio
FROM tx
JOIN mix ON mix.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tx.ordertypedist
ORDER BY shortint_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
